custom separate settings.#comment: THESE SETTINGS APPLY ALWAYS, EVEN IF THE CUSTOM SETTINGS ARE DISABLED.
Defines the hangar to helicopter distance threshold for crew boarding. Default value is 0.08 (NM)
Above preset value (in nautical miles) the crew will arrive transported by a van.
Below (or at) preset value (in nautical miles) the crew will arrive walking.
Defines if checklist voices are played or not and the priority over other mission voices. Default is 0 (checklist+mission audio)
0 - Checklist & mission audio are both played at the same volume
1 - Checklist audio enabled, mission audio momentarily reduced
2 - Checklist audio disabled
Defines if the hospital crew appears before landing at destination helipad or after landing
0 Crew is generated in front of helicopter after landing
1 (DEFAULT) Crew is generated at landing coordinates few NM before reaching the landing spot.
Defines the hospital crew distance from the landing spot center. Default value medic 21, stretcher 19
Reduce in case of rooftop landing spots
Keep/increase if needed
Defines the distance from accident site to the helicopter, in meters, above which the ambulance will be considered far. Default: 100 meters

Defines if the hospital crew walks to hospital with the patient (after unloading) or disappears few seconds after unloading completed. It applies to every ambulance crew (patient transfer or load unload from to ambulance and also for crew boarding and deboarding
0 Crew disappears (no hospital query executed, no risk of query or mission lock)
1 (DEFAULT)Crew moves to the hospital following straight path from loading spot to hospital. (Valid only if Load to ambulance has not been selected)
Defines the speed multiplier (based on road limits) for police and ambulance on scene. Default: 1.5

Defines the rotor speed (NR), in percentage, below which the ground operations may start. Default: 80. Note that idle speed is something around 74-78% and some logics use 90% or less during deceleration for sequences. So please keep the value between 79 to 84% and if there are errors, please report them
